name: crc16-stream
notes: CRC-16/CCITT (x^16+x^12+x^5+1, preset 3) over 32-bit words, MSB first, with the line unit's CRC: 2 cycles per bit (LTIM 1).

Per job the TX queue supplies the initial CRC value (0xFFFF gives CRC-16/IBM-3740, also called CCITT-FALSE; 0 gives XMODEM), the number of data words n >= 1, then n data words (bytes big-endian in each word). The result is pushed to the RX queue.
The data go out on pin 0 as NRZ bits; the pin is owned but its output stays disabled (DIR is never set).
Needs the line unit (options.line_unit rec16, docs/extension.md); assemble with --variant configs/variants/diet8_rec16.json.
